interval_scope: descriptive; adaptive sampling; no simultaneous confidence claim

confirmation.inference_scope: one frozen candidate and prefix 0; independent fixed-distribution replay assumption
confirmation.method: Hoeffding; union bound over two proportions

revision.scope: paired replay of one fixed synthetic case; independent pairs assumed
revision.method: paired Hoeffding bound on differences in [-1,1]
revision.provenance: user-selected upstream scripted intervention; not a generated patch

next_action: Review candidate evidence and test a user-selected revision; root cause and earliest position remain unconfirmed.
